environment: Four independent Chromium processes, real Godot WebGL and local WebRTC. Korean composition uses Chromium IME protocol, not a human OS keyboard. No real microphones or external document accounts.

checks.name: Four real peers join one meeting and type into one report
Korean composition survives another peer inserting text
Four participants share a real image slide, laser, question and task
Two concurrent meetings isolate report, board and agenda
Undo removes my edit while preserving the other participant
Disconnected peer keeps an offline draft and rejoins by state-vector merge
Meeting participation revocation rejects a stale peer rejoin
Export contains both meetings and can be decoded
Fresh session imports both meeting results and the verified slide attachment
